name: Mosonmagyaróvár (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, blue and red with serrated white edges, charged at the centre with the town arms of Mosonmagyaróvár: a crowned red and blue shield with a white castle, a figure and a wavy stripe.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated top, bottom and fly edges
